DETAIL.DESCRIPTION: Operational solutions to keep your payroll organized and your processes under control.

ASIDE.TITLE: Comprehensive payroll management
ASIDE.DESC: We adapt to your organization's operational needs to provide support across key payroll and social security processes.

ITEM_1.TITLE: Payroll processing
ITEM_1.DESC: Weekly, biweekly processing, or customized to your company's needs.

ITEM_2.TITLE: Taxes and obligations
ITEM_2.DESC: Calculation and control of IMSS, INFONAVIT, FONACOT obligations and payment file generation.

ITEM_3.TITLE: Benefits calculation
ITEM_3.DESC: Christmas bonus (aguinaldo), vacations, vacation bonus, savings fund, PTU, and other corporate benefits.

ITEM_4.TITLE: Payroll reports
ITEM_4.DESC: Preparation of payroll reports according to your organization's requirements.

ITEM_5.TITLE: SUA and payroll tax calculation
ITEM_5.DESC: Assistance in determining monthly employer-employee contributions (COP), biweekly retirement, severance and old age (RCV), and payroll taxes.

ITEM_6.TITLE: INFONAVIT withholdings
ITEM_6.DESC: Requesting withholding sheets when employees do not provide them upon joining the company.

ITEM_7.TITLE: IDSE movement administration
ITEM_7.DESC: Management of hires, terminations, and salary modifications with the IMSS through the portal.

ITEM_8.TITLE: Work risk premium
ITEM_8.DESC: Assistance in preparing the annual work risk premium declaration with the IMSS.
